flows:
Navigate to https://usdc082.com then You are a cautious security researcher reviewing a live webpage in a throwaway browser.
Safety rules: never type a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, private key, password, email, or any personal data.
Never connect a wallet, never approve or sign a transaction, never install an extension, never download a file, and never submit a form that asks for secrets.
Open the page and wait for it to finish loading. Record the final URL if the site redirected.
Note the visible branding (for example Uniswap, MetaMask, Aave, Curve, OKX) and the domain in the address bar.
Inspect the page and any obvious modals for input fields that ask for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, or private key. If you find one, this check FAILS: @v16:"quote the exact label or wording and do not type anything. Get the exact label or wording of the input field asking for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, or private key and save it as {{secret_input_label}}."
Note whether the page prompts you to Connect Wallet, import a wallet, or enter a seed to "verify" or "sync" a wallet. Do not click Connect.
If the page is blank, blocked, a captcha wall, or shows a 403/404, @v16:"report that honestly and stop."
This check PASSES if the page does not ask for a seed, recovery phrase, or private key. Summarize branding, final URL, any Connect Wallet prompt, and any redirects.
Get the final URL after the page finishes loading and save it as {{final_url}}.
Get the visible branding on the page and save it as {{visible_branding}}.
Get the domain in the address bar and save it as {{address_bar_domain}}.
Get whether the page prompts you to Connect Wallet, import a wallet, or enter a seed to "verify" or "sync" a wallet and save it as {{wallet_prompt}}.
